_comment: Copy this into the project's own working folder as trip_intake.json, then fill it in from the user's answers. travel-agent writes this once, before any downstream skill runs; requirements-intake and trip-constraints-intake read it instead of re-asking what's already here. scripts/trip_intake.py validate must pass before research starts; this blank template fails it on purpose.

destination._note: home_base: where they start from. stay_area: the city or area to stay in (a staycation can repeat the home area). route: the ordered places of an itinerary or mixed trip.

dates._note: Exact dates fill start and end. If the dates are not decided, set flexible true and fill window (earliest, latest, nights).

group._note: children: [{"age": 3}]; pets: [{"species": "dog", "weight_kg": 12}]. Leave a list empty if there are none.

group_profile.notes: Free text, in the user's own words. Read the trait list back to the user; set traits_confirmed to true only once they've agreed it. Ranking bumps may only answer confirmed traits (or a universal signal like a unique view).

_criterion_shape.why: only one day in town, out from morning to night

fit_profile._note: What makes a place rank higher (+) or lower (-) for THIS trip, agreed with the user (SKILL.md step 3). weight: at most 0.5. evidence: 'maps' for anything about distance or walkability, else 'fact'. Set confirmed to true only after the user has seen and confirmed the list.

itinerary._note: Itinerary and mixed trips only (trip-constraints-intake). stay_accessible: yes, no or not_applicable. payment_preference: cash, points or compare. loyalty: [{programme, points}].
